The host's name, set now and across reboots. On cloud images, cloud-init may reset it at boot unless preserve_hostname is true.

```hcl
step "example" {
  hostname {
    name = "..."
  }
}
```

## Arguments

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | Yes | Hostname, such as web1 or web1.example.com. |

## Read-only attributes

Conn3x sets these; reference them as `conn3x_hostname.<circuit>__<step>["<host>"].<name>`.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `in_sync` | bool | Whether the host has this setting. |
| `revision` | string | Changes each time Conn3x changes this on the host. Handlers watch it. |

A step lowers to the `conn3x_hostname` resource, one instance per host, and connects with its circuit's `ssh` block.
